description: Show whether this machine is signed in to Polydev, which sources on this machine are ready (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT plan) and the configured models. When this machine is not signed in, it opens Polydev sign-in in the browser.

user_token.description: Polydev token (starts with pd_). Optional: checks this token if given, otherwise the saved one.

name: get_auth_status
title: Polydev status
